attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Sun Throne razed Fenwick, as I reported last time.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a full item rather than a short clause; the new fact is that it razed Fenwick and is besieging, but this is old"},{"span":"It is a shame about the architecture","severity":"minor","reason":"implies Fenwick had notable architecture, which the briefing does not give"}],"voice":4,"clarity":4,"tone":4,"overall":3,"comment":"The dry voice is good and the siege lead is correct, but the second item retells the Fenwick razing as a full item instead of a short old-news clause, and the architecture line adds an unsupported detail.
